newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Ivorian government cuts minimum share price.
newsitem.headline: Ivorian government cuts minimum share price.

text.p: Ivory Coast's government has cut the minimium nominal price of shares on the Abidjan Bourse from 2,500 CFA francs to 500 CFA in a bid to boost public share ownership.
The move was announced in a cabinet statement published on Thursday in the government newspaper Fraternite Matin.
The government said that the level of 2,500 CFA had proved too high.

"This order aims to remedy this... to make it easier for members of the Ivorian public to participate in the capital of societies that remain to be privatised and to take an active part in the development of a nation of shareholders."
Ivory Coast's government has sold all or part of its stake in 35 of the 62 companies earmarked for privatisation.
